en.meta.description: Polar Bear sets up a fresh macOS or Linux terminal in one command: Catppuccin Starship prompt, Zsh, eza, bat, fzf, zoxide, lazygit and more.
en.hero.title: After installing, type just 3 commands — and your terminal looks like this.
en.hero.lead: Polar Bear sets up Zsh, a Catppuccin Starship prompt, and modern CLI tools — eza, bat, fzf, zoxide, lazygit, delta — on macOS and Linux. No terminal emulator to install, no config to babysit.
en.hero.subtitle: Old configs auto-backed up · Preview with --dry-run · Safe to re-run
en.hero.value: Not another dotfiles repo — a previewable, repeatable installer that won't break your setup.
en.hero.previewAlt: Terminal before and after setup: plain shell on the left, icons / highlights / git branch on the right
en.hero.caption: BEFORE → AFTER, just 3 commands away.
hero.get3: 🎨 Colorful prompt: Catppuccin theme + git branch
🚀 Modern ls · cat: eza / bat with icons & highlights
🧭 Smart jumps + fuzzy search: zoxide / fzf
convert.who: A brand-new Mac and you want the terminal set up in one go
Reinstalling or switching machines and rebuilding a familiar dev environment
Keeping several machines consistent without putting private tweaks into public dotfiles
en.convert.star: A ⭐ helps others find it in search — entirely optional, just a way to let a good tool be seen.
en.convert.fork: Fork the repo and tailor configs/ and setup.sh to your own habits; your changes stay in your fork and never affect upstream.
en.features.title: Core features
en.videos.title: Advanced video guides
en.videos.v1d: One line auto-clones, or review setup.sh first; --dry-run previews every step and never blocks in non-interactive runs.
en.videos.v2d: ls / cat / smart z jumps / fzf search / top monitor / fastfetch — common commands use the shortest aliases; fd / rg are used directly and never override system find / grep (no flag conflicts).
en.videos.v3d: Catppuccin prompt shows branch state, lg browses the repo, and git diff is highlighted by delta.

features.title: Unified theme

features.desc: eza / bat / fd / rg / fzf / zoxide / lazygit / delta, all covered and ready; fd = faster find, rg = faster grep — system find/grep are left untouched to avoid flag conflicts.

features.title: One-command install
features.desc: Zero config, ready in minutes. Local tweaks live in ~/.zshrc.local and survive re-runs.

features.title: Terminal agnostic
features.desc: Use your existing terminal; Warp recommended (optional, not installed).

features.title: Chinese friendly
features.desc: Maple Mono NF CN font: crisp glyphs, icons and Chinese text.

features.title: Previewable
features.desc: --dry-run prints every step first; non-interactive runs never block on prompts.
